---
title: "Keyboard Shortcuts"
---

ESC -- will close any open window (except the main window)

U -- undo the zoom

Z -- Pan the graph one window right (useful when zoomed in)

X -- Pan the graph one window left (useful when zoomed in)

A or S -- hold while clicking plot zoom buttons for axis specific zooming (A: x-axis, S: y-axis)

D -- (in *Events* mode) holding D while selecting a region on plot allows deletion of multiple events at once.

## Events Refine / Analysis Window

When an analysis has been run, keyboard shortcuts are available for scrolling through, moving to and deleting events. When the Refine / Events Analyze window is open:

Right arrow -- scroll to the next event

Left arrow -- scroll to the previous event

Up -- go to the event (the main plot will be moved so that the selected event is in the center)

Space -- delete the selected event from analysis
